text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yasuda Kinen conquered! This is a victory 
I grabbed because I pushed past my limits 
while working hard to beat Oguri-senpai, 
ss'u!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I told Yaeno! It's because Oguri-senpai is 
so strong that she makes everyone's 
"dreams" shine brighter— she's the 
strongest, greatest Umamusume ever!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And then, Yaeno remembered the mindset 
needed when challenging the "strong," and 
she took off running toward her "dream" 
once again, ssusu!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Today's race made it clear: Oguri-senpai 
is right at the center of my "dream." 
That's why I want to become the greatest 
rival she could ever have.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To get stronger, my next goal is the 
Takarazuka Kinen! A race where Yaeno and 
Chiyono O run, where the "dreams" of our 
generation gather!
